text: That duration suggests a subacute process; have you noticed any fever, night sweats, or unintentional weight loss accompanying the cough? Also, do you have a history of smoking or recent exposure to dust or chemicals?

speaker: Patient
text: No, I haven't had any fever, night sweats, or lost any weight. Yes, I have a significant history of smoking, having worked as a construction worker for many years before quitting five years ago.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your significant smoking history and the production of white phlegm, have you experienced any chest pain, wheezing, or shortness of breath that worsens with exertion? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray REQUEST TEST: Sputum_Culture

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the chest X-ray and sputum culture are normal, have you noticed any swelling in your ankles or a sensation of fullness in your neck or face? Additionally, does your shortness of breath improve when you sit up and worsen when you lie flat?

speaker: Patient
text: No, I haven't noticed any swelling in my ankles or a feeling of fullness in my neck or face. As for my breathing, the shortness of breath mainly happens when I try to exert myself, but it doesn't seem to change much depending on whether I'm sitting up or lying down.

speaker: Doctor

speaker: Patient

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal cardiac and pulmonary workup, along with your history of smoking and recent anxiety, could you describe exactly where you feel this vague pressure and whether it changes with deep breathing or movement? Also, have you noticed any recent life stressors or significant changes in your daily routine?

speaker: Patient

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Anxiety Disorder with Somatic Symptom Disorder (presenting as chest tightness and cough).
